subject: Private deployment — custody & operator access / MSA + Order Form coordination
messages:
From: Kevin Hartman <kevin.hartman@medtech.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: MedTech Procurement <procurement@medtech.co>
Date: 2027-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood MSA/Order Form — private deployment requests

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement and legal at MedTech want to lock down a couple of items for the on-prem/VPC deployment before we move forward with the order form:

1) License scope: we need confirmation that the MSA + Order Form will permit the model runtime to be operated within our VPC and that our operators can perform snapshot restoration for DR scenarios.
2) Operator access/evidence: legal is asking for an "operator-witness" or escrow-like pathway for snapshots — procedural evidence that Redwood can produce a sealed snapshot (or witness) on request, plus an attestation timeline.
3) Audit window & proof: we will need a short audit window (48–72 hours) for a one-time forensic snapshot verification during onboarding and a mechanism to request logs/trace for a 90-day retention period.

I've attached MedTech_Audit_Reqs.pdf with specific language they prefer. Can Redwood confirm whether the proposed redline path is feasible, and if not, propose alternate language? We are aiming to sign the order form by end of May.

Thanks,
Kevin

--
Kevin Hartman
VP, IT Security
MedTech Systems
kevin.hartman@medtech.co
+1 415 555 0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Hartman <kevin.hartman@medtech.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA/Order Form — private deployment requests

Kevin — thanks for the clear summary and the attachment. Looping in Marissa from Legal to help with proposed contract language. Quick reactions:

- License scope: we can confirm the MSA+Order Form will permit operation of Redwood runtime in your VPC under a Private Deployment exhibit. We need to capture the exact territorial/usage boundaries in Exhibit A (Order Form).
- Operator witness / sealed snapshot: we offer a pragmatic compromise: Redwood can provide a sealed snapshot and an operator attestation (signed statement) plus an optional witnessed verification session by an approved third-party (mutually agreeable) in case of dispute. This avoids full source-escrow but meets many procurement requirements.
- Audit window & logs: we can commit to a defined evidence package for onboarding (forensic snapshot + access logs) and 90-day retention for the relevant telemetry; we will want to limit scope to tokens/ops metadata (no PII unless contractually allowed).

Can you confirm whether MedTech requires a persistent escrow deposit vs. a one-time witness event? That will change the redline. Assuming one-time witnessed verification is OK, we can draft Exhibit: "Witnessed Snapshot and Attestation" for the MSA and add an Order Form clause for the on-prem install checklist.

I'll produce a short strawman and Marissa can advise on the legal-equivalent wording. Proposed next step: 1) Marissa and I draft exhibit language; 2) we share a redline to your legal by EOD Tuesday; 3) procurement confirms timeline.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Hartman <kevin.hartman@medtech.co>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA/Order Form — private deployment requests

Kevin — thanks for the attachment and the good context. Attaching a short proposed draft (MSA-Proposed-Exhibit-Licensing.docx) but high level options below — aim to keep it operational rather than full escrow:

1) Exhibit: "Private Deployment — Operator Evidence & Snapshot Witness" (Order Form references exhibit):
   - Redwood will provide a sealed forensic snapshot upon written request tied to a Trigger Event (onboarding verification, regulatory audit, or agreed forensic review).
   - Snapshot delivery: encrypted TAR with manifest, delivered to MedTech SFTP or mutually agreed transfer method.
   - Witness option: Redwood offers an optional remote witnessed verification session with an approved independent forensic verifier. Customer covers verifier fees unless contract states otherwise.

2) Attestation: Redwood will provide an officer-signed attestation describing snapshot creation date, checksums, and process steps; attestation to be part of the evidence package.

3) Access scope & logs: Redwood will provide 90-day runtime logs/trace related to the snapshot (API-level metadata, model version, request timestamps). PII must be redacted or delivered only under a separate data processing agreement.

4) Limitations & SLA carveouts: For on-prem/VPC, Redwood will document operator runbook and provide support access (secure, time-limited), but will not retain persistent keys in customer environment. We propose a 30-day response SLA for evidence requests with a 10-business-day window for witnessed verification scheduling.

If that tracks, Karthik and I can drop these into a clean redline vs. your MSA/Order Form. Two open questions for procurement/legal: (a) who signs the attestation (Redwood officer vs. designated engineer) and (b) whether the verifier will have bidirectional NDA protections.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachment: MSA-Proposed-Exhibit-Licensing.docx (see attached — draft language + bullet points)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Kevin Hartman <kevin.hartman@medtech.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood MSA/Order Form — private deployment requests

Kevin — following up and offering concrete next steps so we can keep to your end-of-May timeline.

1) Commitment: Redwood can accept the approach in Marissa's draft: sealed snapshot + officer attestation + optional independent witness. We will add these as Exhibit X (Private Deployment Evidence) and a short Order Form clause referencing the exhibit.

2) Timeline: Redwood will produce a redline of the MSA + Order Form (including Exhibit X) and return to MedTech legal by 2027-05-13 COB. Once you confirm the witness vs. escrow preference (one-time witness is our recommended default), we will finalize the exhibit.

3) Logistics: Please confirm the following so we can draft transfer/proof steps in the redline:
   - Preferred transfer method for snapshot (SFTP / secure share / alternative)
   - Whether verifier needs standalone NDA or can rely on the MSA confidentiality section
   - Point of contact for scheduling the witnessed session (name/email)

If you approve, I'll push the redline to DocuSign (pre-sign routing for Redwood signature) and share the HubSpot record for tracking.

Thanks — we want to keep this lightweight and audit-friendly.

-David

--
David Kim
Director, Legal Operations
Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com
